name: Office Routine
source:
Think office work is boring? In this game, you'll get to work with cute girl coworkers! Don't forget to do your job well! You don't want to get fired, do you? Many sweet and naughty scenes await you!! 

[From [url=https://furmirui.itch.io/office-routine]Itch.io[/url]]
